snippet.title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater HD Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Tony Hawk is back in this HD remake of the classic skateboarding title that turned a generation of gamers into virtual skateboarders! Leave your favorite THPS memories in the comments!
